required: complete current participant and sheet references
complete current source-owned blocking fact list
authoritySnapshot.rule: A partial, client-asserted, malformed, duplicate, or over-limit authority snapshot is rejected rather than interpreted as an empty blocker list.

documentFacts.open unlinked bounded decision: private-choice, or gm-adjudication only for a gm-correction decision
documentFacts.decision-required consequence: private-choice until its exact bounded decision is accepted
documentFacts.decision-required cleanup: cleanup-decision until its exact bounded decision is accepted

derivedGates.gateIdentity: SHA-256 over version, settlement identity, gate kind, and stable private source-fact identity
derivedGates.openingRevision: Preserve the matching current gate opening revision; otherwise use the evaluated settlement revision.

revisionRules.currentRevisionBelowDraft: revision-conflict with correction only; rollback is never treated as fresh authority
revisionRules.campaignMinute: rollback is contradictory and advance is stale; browser time has no authority

requiredDecision.gateSubjects: exactly one current stable gate identity
requiredDecision.selection: one offered option whose value is a legal gate resolution and whose effect is the matching correct, exclude, or adjudicate/waive effect
requiredDecision.authority: the selected option names one exact current gate authority

requiredReceipt.time: same authoritative campaign minute as the accepted decision

gmAdjudication.rule: GM role alone, prose, a missing receipt, a changed authority revision, a mismatched option, or a correction aimed at another gate never removes a blocker.

outcomes.eligible: No current unresolved gate remains and the next draft status is ready.
outcomes.blocked: At least one current unresolved gate remains and the next draft status is blocked.
outcomes.committing: An existing committing settlement is not re-opened or declared eligible.
outcomes.terminal: A completed or cancelled settlement is not re-opened or declared eligible.

privacy.gateProjection: Later role projection may expose only safe blocker labels, counts, ownership, and legal actions.
